title: Reports: Caleb Williams to start for Bears Sunday

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Reports: Caleb Williams to start for Bears Sunday
sources.description: Bears quarterback Caleb Williams was coy about his availability for Sunday's game against the Falcons during a Friday press conference, but he seemed to send a message with a social media post later in the day.
